definition.write: each of the 20 describe sentences is written once with a write-enabled observe
definition.features: state.fast flattened, float64, centred per fold with an appended bias column
definition.readout: closed-form ridge W=(XtX+lI)^-1 XtY over the 20-way one-hot sentence label
definition.folds: fixed index % 5; 16 train, 4 test per fold
definition.control: the same pipeline with permuted labels (fixed seed) must stay near chance
definition.decision: best accuracy over the lambda grid >= 0.5 -> write_path_retains_content
definition.closed_state: the nine legacy readings on the main subject stay equal before and after

criteria.features: 20 finite feature vectors with matching label count
criteria.grid: accuracy is reported for every lambda
criteria.control: the permuted-label control is <= 0.2, otherwise inconclusive
criteria.closed_state: the nine legacy readings stay equal and the main parameter digest does not move
criteria.rerun: the R47 anchor carries a commit, a runner blob sha1, a runner sha256 and a core sha256
